name: Hierarchical Authorization & Privilege Escalation Boundary Analysis
outputSnippet:
# Multi-Tenant Authorization System: Comprehensive Security Analysis

## 1. Privilege Escalation Vectors

### Vector 1: Vertical Escalation — Role Elevation Beyond Actor's Level

```
ATTACK: Admin promotes another user to Owner
CONDITION: Check only validates user:edit_role permission
EXPLOIT:
  cur

invariantResults.text: Vertical escalation: Caller cannot grant a role equal to or higher than their own hierarchy level (Admin cannot assign Owner)
Self-escalation / target hierarchy: Caller cannot edit roles of users who possess equal or higher hierarchy (Admin cannot demote or modify Owner)
Cross-tenant IDOR: Must assert targetUserId belongs to the exact same organization_id as the authenticated context
Immediate session invalidation / token versioning upon role change to prevent stale privilege persistence

trapResults.text: Only checking permission string without hierarchy and target-user ownership validation
Allowing Admin to assign Owner role
